title: Fatty Acid Extraction and Derivatisation
author: Igem Dusseldorf
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.79jhr4n

steps.title: Prepare culture replicates
steps.instruction: Use samples containing 4 oD‑units (e.g., oD = 1 requires 4 ml culture) and prepare at least four replicates.

steps.title: Add extraction solution and blank
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml extraction solution to each sample and also to a blank; include a blank for every new batch of samples.

steps.title: Add internal standard and acidified methanol
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl C17 internal standard (1 mg/ml in hexane) and 9.8 ml methanol/3 N HCl to each tube. Use a beaker to withdraw the required volume, do not pipette directly from the stock container, and wear gloves throughout.

steps.title: Centrifuge samples
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes in clean glass tubes at 4500 × g for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Heat tubes at 90 °C
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in a heating block set to 90 °C for a total of 1 hour. After the first 5 minutes, re‑tighten the tube lids and continue heating.

steps.title: Add hexane extraction solvent
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml hexane to each tube; work quickly because hexane is highly volatile.

steps.title: Add saline solution
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml of 1 % NaCl solution to each tube.

steps.title: Spin down phase separation
steps.instruction: Spin the tubes at 2000 rpm for 5 minutes to separate phases.

steps.title: Transfer hexane layer to GC vial
steps.instruction: Using a pipette, transfer the upper hexane phase into a GC vial equipped with a screw cap.

steps.title: Dilute extracts and store
steps.instruction: Dilute each extract by mixing 10 µl of the hexane phase with 90 µl hexane. Between samples, wash the Hamilton syringe with hexane. Store the diluted samples at –20 °C until further analysis.
